posts.title: Lester Park Surf
posts.description: So I surfed Stoney Point a couple weeks ago and just yesterday, I surfed Lester Park . The surf conditions were looking solid, hurricane Isaias in Florida must have pushed enough hot air north that there was need for correction. posts.title: AI Burnout
posts.description: Five months since my last tech post. Not super surprising given that I started my new job in March of this year, but also a little sad that as an “AI” engineer, I haven’t learned anything new worth writing about since starting the role. The team I’m on is a small team and we own a lot (it’s what I signed up for), so I’m not jaded at all, but I do find that AI has sucked the joy out of programming

posts.title: Exploring The 1 & 101 North of SLO
posts.description: It was our last full day in Morro Bay on Wednesday, and we decided to visit Hearst Castle since it was so gloomy and there was zero surf. So, we made a similar drive to Sand Dollar and just rode the 1 up a bit past San Simeon and made it to the visitors center.
